usage.exampleZh: 这表明，过了何等漫长的岁月，我们才认为有必要确保所有孩子都能分享过去几个世纪里“幸运的少数人”积累的知识。

usage.note: to 后接名词或动词原形，此处后接 equal start。
usage.example: All are entitled to an equal start.
usage.exampleZh: 所有人都有权享有平等的起点。

rows.en: Parents are often upset when their children praise the homes of their friends and regard it as a slur on their own cooking, or cleaning, or furniture, and often are foolish enough to let the adolescents see that they are annoyed.
rows.zh: 孩子赞美朋友家时，父母往往感到不快，认为这是在贬低自家的饭菜、清洁或家具，而且常常愚蠢到让这些青春期孩子看出自己生气了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They may even accuse them of disloyalty, or make some spiteful remark about the friends’ parents.
rows.zh: 他们甚至可能责怪孩子不忠于自家，或对朋友的父母说些刻薄话。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Such a loss of dignity and descent into childish behaviour on the part of the adults deeply shocks the adolescents, and makes them resolve that in future they will not talk to their parents about the places or people they visit.
rows.zh: 成年人如此丧失尊严，退而作出幼稚举动，会使青少年大为震惊，并决心今后不再向父母谈起自己到过的地方或见过的人。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Before very long the parents will be complaining that the child is so secretive and never tells them anything, but they seldom realize that they have brought this on themselves.
rows.zh: 没过多久，父母就会抱怨孩子过分保密，什么都不告诉他们，却很少意识到这是他们自己招来的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Disillusionment with the parents, however good and adequate they may be both as parents and as individuals, is to some degree inevitable.
rows.zh: 不论父母作为家长和个人多么优秀、称职，孩子对他们的理想化信念破灭，在某种程度上仍是不可避免的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Most children have such a high ideal of their parents, unless the parents themselves have been unsatisfactory, that it can hardly hope to stand up to a realistic evaluation.
rows.zh: 除非父母本身表现得不尽如人意，多数孩子都会把父母想得极其完美，以至于这种理想化形象几乎不可能经得住现实的评价。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Parents would be greatly surprised and deeply touched if they realized how much belief their children usually have in their character and infallibility, and how much this faith means to a child.
rows.zh: 如果父母意识到，孩子通常多么相信他们的品格与永不犯错，又意识到这种信念对孩子有多重要，父母一定会十分惊讶，深受感动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If parents were prepared for this adolescent reaction, and realized that it was a sign that the child was growing up and developing valuable powers of observation and independent judgment, they would not be so hurt, and therefore would not drive the child into opposition by resenting and resisting it.
rows.zh: 假如父母对青春期的这种反应有所准备，并明白这是孩子正在长大、正在培养宝贵的观察能力和独立判断力的迹象，他们便不会如此受伤，也就不会因愤恨和抵制这种反应，而把孩子推到对立面去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The adolescent, with his passion for sincerity, always respects a parent who admits that he is wrong, or ignorant, or even that he has been unfair or unjust.
rows.zh: 青少年热切地追求真诚；对于肯承认自己犯错、无知，甚至曾经不公平、不公正的父母，他们总是尊重的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: What the child cannot forgive is the parents’ refusal to admit these charges if the child knows them to be true.
rows.zh: 孩子不能原谅的是，当他明知这些指责属实，父母却拒绝承认。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Victorian parents believed that they kept their dignity by retreating behind an unreasoning authoritarian attitude; in fact they did nothing of the kind, but children were then too cowed to let them know how they really felt.
rows.zh: 维多利亚时代的父母相信，退到不讲道理的专制态度后面就能保住尊严；其实完全没有做到，但当时的孩子吓得太厉害，不敢让父母知道自己的真实感受。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Today we tend to go to the other extreme, but on the whole this is a healthier attitude both for the child and the parent.
rows.zh: 如今我们往往走向另一个极端，不过总的说来，这种态度对孩子和父母都更健康。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is always wiser and safer to face up to reality, however painful it may be at the moment.
rows.zh: 直面现实总是更明智、更稳妥的，哪怕当下会感到痛苦。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 用于指出某行为或态度来自哪一方。
usage.example: Such a loss of dignity and descent into childish behaviour on the part of the adults deeply shocks the adolescents, and makes them resolve that in future they will not talk to their parents about the places or people they visit.
usage.exampleZh: 成年人如此丧失尊严，退而作出幼稚举动，会使青少年大为震惊，并决心今后不再向父母谈起自己到过的地方或见过的人。

usage.note: 常指因自己的行为造成不好的后果，宾语放在 bring 与 on 之间。
usage.example: Before very long the parents will be complaining that the child is so secretive and never tells them anything, but they seldom realize that they have brought this on themselves.
usage.exampleZh: 没过多久，父母就会抱怨孩子过分保密，什么都不告诉他们，却很少意识到这是他们自己招来的。

usage.note: 此处指承受检验或评价，不是起身面对某人。
usage.example: Most children have such a high ideal of their parents, unless the parents themselves have been unsatisfactory, that it can hardly hope to stand up to a realistic evaluation.
usage.exampleZh: 除非父母本身表现得不尽如人意，多数孩子都会把父母想得极其完美，以至于这种理想化形象几乎不可能经得住现实的评价。

usage.note: 综合考虑后作总体判断，容许个别例外。
usage.example: Today we tend to go to the other extreme, but on the whole this is a healthier attitude both for the child and the parent.
usage.exampleZh: 如今我们往往走向另一个极端，不过总的说来，这种态度对孩子和父母都更健康。

usage.note: 比 face 更强调承认并应对困难的现实。
usage.example: It is always wiser and safer to face up to reality, however painful it may be at the moment.
usage.exampleZh: 直面现实总是更明智、更稳妥的，哪怕当下会感到痛苦。

rows.en: The Moon is likely to become the industrial hub of the Solar System, supplying the rocket fuels for its ships, easily obtainable from the lunar rocks in the form of liquid oxygen.
rows.zh: 月球很可能成为太阳系的工业中心，为宇宙飞船供应火箭燃料；这种燃料就是容易从月岩中获得的液态氧。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The reason lies in its gravity.
rows.zh: 原因在于月球的引力。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Because the Moon has only an eightieth of the Earth’s mass, it requires 97 per cent less energy to travel the quarter of a million miles from the Moon to Earth-orbit than the 200 mile-journey from Earth's surface into orbit!
rows.zh: 月球的质量只有地球的八十分之一，因此，从月球飞行二十五万英里到达地球轨道，所需能量竟比从地球表面飞行二百英里进入轨道少百分之九十七！
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This may sound fantastic, but it is easily calculated.
rows.zh: 这听来可能不可思议，但很容易计算出来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: To escape from the Earth in a rocket, one must travel at seven miles per second.
rows.zh: 要乘火箭摆脱地球引力，必须达到每秒七英里的速度。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The comparable speed from the Moon is only 1.5 miles per second.
rows.zh: 在月球上，相应的速度仅为每秒一点五英里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Because the gravity on the Moon's surface is only a sixth of Earth’s (remember how easily the Apollo astronauts bounded along), it takes much less energy to accelerate to that 1.5 miles per second than it does on Earth.
rows.zh: 月表引力只有地球的六分之一——想想阿波罗宇航员当年轻松跳跃前进的样子——因此，加速到每秒一点五英里所需的能量，比在地球上少得多。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Moon-dwellers will be able to fly in space at only three per cent of the cost of similar journeys by their terrestrial cousins.
rows.zh: 月球居民进行太空飞行的费用，将仅为地球上的同胞进行类似旅行所需费用的百分之三。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Arthur C. Clark once suggested a revolutionary idea passes through three phases:
rows.zh: 阿瑟·C.克拉克曾提出，一个革命性构想会经历三个阶段：
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: 1 ‘It’s impossible — don’t waste my time.’
rows.zh: 一、“不可能——别浪费我的时间。”
rows.speaker: 假想的公众反应

rows.en: 2 ‘It’s possible, but not worth doing.’
rows.zh: 二、“有可能，但不值得做。”
rows.speaker: 假想的公众反应

rows.en: 3 ‘I said it was a good idea all along.’
rows.zh: 三、“我一直就说这是个好主意。”
rows.speaker: 假想的公众反应

rows.en: The idea of colonising Mars — a world 160 times more distant than the Moon — will move decisively from the second phase to the third, when a significant number of people are living permanently in space.
rows.zh: 火星的距离是月球的一百六十倍；当有相当数量的人永久居住在太空时，移居火星的构想就会明确地从第二阶段转入第三阶段。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Mars has an extraordinary fascination for would-be voyagers.
rows.zh: 对于那些想去远航的人，火星有着非同寻常的吸引力。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: America, Russia and Europe are filled with enthusiasts — many of them serious and senior scientists — who dream of sending people to it.
rows.zh: 美国、俄罗斯和欧洲都有大量怀抱热情的人，其中许多是严谨而资深的科学家，梦想着把人送到火星。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Their aim is understandable.
rows.zh: 他们的目标可以理解。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is the one world in the Solar System that is most like the Earth.
rows.zh: 在太阳系各个世界中，火星与地球最为相似。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is a world of red sandy deserts (hence its name — the Red Planet), cloudless skies, savage sandstorms, chasms wider than the Grand Canyon and at least one mountain more than twice as tall as Everest.
rows.zh: 那是一个有着红色沙漠、无云天空、猛烈沙暴、比大峡谷更宽的深渊，以及至少一座高度超过珠穆朗玛峰两倍的山峰的世界——也正因那红色沙漠，它才被称为“红色行星”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It seems ideal for settlement.
rows.zh: 它似乎是理想的定居之地。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 常用于指出原因、问题或价值所在，后接关键因素。
usage.example: The reason lies in its gravity.
usage.exampleZh: 原因在于月球的引力。

usage.note: from 引出离开的地方或摆脱的力量；这里指火箭摆脱地球引力。
usage.example: To escape from the Earth in a rocket, one must travel at seven miles per second.
usage.exampleZh: 要乘火箭摆脱地球引力，必须达到每秒七英里的速度。

usage.note: 强调某事贯穿整个过程，此处带有事后自称先见之明的讽刺。
usage.example: 3 ‘I said it was a good idea all along.’
usage.exampleZh: 三、“我一直就说这是个好主意。”

usage.note: would-be 作定语表示怀有某种志向，不保证已经实现。
usage.example: Mars has an extraordinary fascination for would-be voyagers.
usage.exampleZh: 对于那些想去远航的人，火星有着非同寻常的吸引力。

usage.note: of 后接名词或动名词，表示渴望实现某事。
usage.example: America, Russia and Europe are filled with enthusiasts — many of them serious and senior scientists — who dream of sending people to it.
usage.exampleZh: 美国、俄罗斯和欧洲都有大量怀抱热情的人，其中许多是严谨而资深的科学家，梦想着把人送到火星。

rows.en: If a nation is essentially disunited, it is left to the government to hold it together.
rows.zh: 如果一个国家根本上缺乏团结，维系它的任务便落在政府身上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This increases the expense of government, and reduces correspondingly the amount of economic resources that could be used for developing the country.
rows.zh: 这会增加政府的开支，并相应减少本可用于国家发展的经济资源。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: And it should not be forgotten how small those resources are in a poor and backward country.
rows.zh: 而且，我们不应忘记，在一个贫穷落后的国家，这些资源原本就少得可怜。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Where the cost of government is high, resources for development are correspondingly low.
rows.zh: 政府开支高，用于发展的资源就相应少。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This may be illustrated by comparing the position of a nation with that of a private business enterprise.
rows.zh: 把国家的处境与私人企业作比较，可以说明这一点。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: An enterprise has to incur certain costs and expenses in order to stay in business.
rows.zh: 企业为了继续经营，必须承担一定的成本和费用。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For our purposes, we are concerned only with one kind of cost—the cost of managing and administering the business.
rows.zh: 就这里的讨论而言，我们只关心一种费用——经营管理企业的费用。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Such administrative overheads in a business are analogous to the cost of government in a nation.
rows.zh: 企业的这种行政管理间接费用，与国家的政府开支相类似。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The administrative overheads of a business are low to the extent that everyone working in the business can be trusted to behave in a way that best promotes the interests of the firm.
rows.zh: 企业里每个人越是值得信任，能够以最有利于公司利益的方式行事，企业的行政管理费用就越低。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If they can each be trusted to take such responsibilities, and to exercise such initiative as falls within their sphere, then administrative overheads will be low.
rows.zh: 如果可以相信每个人都会在自己的职责范围内承担责任、发挥主动性，行政管理费用就会低。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It will be low because it will be necessary to have only one man looking after each job, without having another man to check upon what he is doing, keep him in line, and report on him to someone else.
rows.zh: 之所以低，是因为每项工作只需一个人负责，不必再安排另一个人检查他的所作所为，管束他，并向其他人汇报他的情况。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But if no one can be trusted to act in a loyal and responsible manner towards his job, then the business will require armies of administrators, checkers, and foremen, and administrative overheads will rise correspondingly.
rows.zh: 但如果没有人能够在工作上忠诚而负责地行事，企业就会需要大批管理员、检查员和领班，行政管理费用也会随之上涨。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As administrative overheads rise, so the earnings of the business after meeting the expense of administration, will fall; and the business will have less money to distribute as dividends or invest directly in its future progress and development.
rows.zh: 随着行政管理费用上涨，企业扣除管理支出后的收益便会下降，可用于发放股息或直接投资于未来进步与发展的资金也就减少。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is precisely the same with a nation.
rows.zh: 国家的情况完全相同。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: To the extent that the people can be relied upon to behave in a loyal and responsible manner, the government does not require armies of police and civil servants to keep them in order.
rows.zh: 只要人民值得信赖，能忠诚而负责地行事，政府就不需要大批警察和公务员来维持秩序。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But if a nation is disunited, the government cannot be sure that the actions of the people will be in the interests of the nation; and it will have to watch, check, and control the people accordingly.
rows.zh: 但如果国家不团结，政府就无法确信人民的行为会符合国家利益，于是便不得不相应地监视、检查和控制人民。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A disunited nation therefore has to incur unduly high costs of government.
rows.zh: 因此，一个不团结的国家必定要承担过高的政府开支。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 强调企业继续运转、未退出市场的状态。
usage.example: An enterprise has to incur certain costs and expenses in order to stay in business.
usage.exampleZh: 企业为了继续经营，必须承担一定的成本和费用。

usage.note: 正式表达，说明两个事物在结构或关系上可作类比。
usage.example: Such administrative overheads in a business are analogous to the cost of government in a nation.
usage.exampleZh: 企业的这种行政管理间接费用，与国家的政府开支相类似。

usage.note: 将结果与条件成立的程度相联，此处信任程度决定管理成本。
usage.example: The administrative overheads of a business are low to the extent that everyone working in the business can be trusted to behave in a way that best promotes the interests of the firm.
usage.exampleZh: 企业里每个人越是值得信任，能够以最有利于公司利益的方式行事，企业的行政管理费用就越低。

usage.note: keep someone in line 表示监督其遵守要求。
usage.example: It will be low because it will be necessary to have only one man looking after each job, without having another man to check upon what he is doing, keep him in line, and report on him to someone else.
usage.exampleZh: 之所以低，是因为每项工作只需一个人负责，不必再安排另一个人检查他的所作所为，管束他，并向其他人汇报他的情况。

usage.note: interests 常用复数，表示某人或群体的利益。
usage.example: But if a nation is disunited, the government cannot be sure that the actions of the people will be in the interests of the nation; and it will have to watch, check, and control the people accordingly.
usage.exampleZh: 但如果国家不团结，政府就无法确信人民的行为会符合国家利益，于是便不得不相应地监视、检查和控制人民。

rows.en: At the age of twelve years, the human body is at its most vigorous.
rows.zh: 十二岁时，人体的生命力最旺盛。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It has yet to reach its full size and strength, and its owner his or her full intelligence; but at this age the likelihood of death is least.
rows.zh: 身体的大小与力量尚未完全长成，人的智力也尚未充分发展，但这个年龄死亡的可能性最低。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Earlier, we were infants and young children, and consequently more vulnerable; later, we shall undergo a progressive loss of our vigour and resistance which, though imperceptible at first, will finally become so steep that we can live no longer, however well we look after ourselves, and however well society, and our doctors, look after us.
rows.zh: 此前，我们是婴儿和幼童，因此更加脆弱；此后，我们的活力和抵抗力便会逐步衰退，起初虽然察觉不到，最终却会急剧衰退到无法继续生存的程度，无论我们自己多么精心保养，也无论社会和医生如何周到地照料我们。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This decline in vigour with the passing of time is called ageing.
rows.zh: 这种随时间流逝而出现的活力衰退，就叫衰老。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is one of the most unpleasant discoveries which we all make that we must decline in this way, that if we escape wars, accidents and diseases we shall eventually ‘die of old age’, and that this happens at a rate which differs little from person to person, so that there are heavy odds in favour of our dying between the ages of sixty-five and eighty.
rows.zh: 我们都会发现一个极其令人不快的事实：自己必定会这样衰退，即使躲过战争、意外和疾病，最终也会“老死”；而这种过程的速度在人与人之间相差很小，因此我们很有可能在六十五岁到八十岁之间去世。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Some of us will die sooner, a few will live longer—on into a ninth or tenth decade.
rows.zh: 我们有些人会早些去世，少数会活得更久，活到八九十岁。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But the chances are against it, and there is a virtual limit on how long we can hope to remain alive, however lucky and robust we are.
rows.zh: 不过，这种长寿的机会并不大；无论我们多么幸运、健壮，能够期望活多久，实际上总有一个限度。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Normal people tend to forget this process unless and until they are reminded of it.
rows.zh: 一般人往往会忘记这个过程，除非有人提醒，才会想起来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We are so familiar with the fact that man ages, that people have for years assumed that the process of losing vigour with time, of becoming more likely to die the older we get, was something self-evident, like the cooling of a hot kettle or the wearing-out of a pair of shoes.
rows.zh: 人会衰老这个事实，我们实在太熟悉了，以至于多年来人们一直以为，活力随时间衰退、年纪越大越容易死亡的过程，是不言自明的，就像热水壶冷却或鞋子穿坏一样。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They have also assumed that all animals, and probably other organisms such as trees, or even the universe itself, must in the nature of things ‘wear out’.
rows.zh: 人们也以为，一切动物，或许还有树木等其他生物，甚至宇宙本身，都必然会依事物的本性而“耗损殆尽”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Most animals we commonly observe do in fact age as we do, if given the chance to live long enough; and mechanical systems like a wound watch, or the sun, do in fact run out of energy in accordance with the second law of thermodynamics (whether the whole universe does so is a moot point at present).
rows.zh: 我们通常见到的大多数动物，如果有机会活得足够长，确实也像我们一样衰老；上了发条的表或太阳这样的机械性系统，也确实会依照热力学第二定律耗尽能量（整个宇宙是否如此，目前仍有争议）。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But these are not analogous to what happens when man ages.
rows.zh: 但这些与人衰老时发生的情况并不相同。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A run-down watch is still a watch and can be rewound.
rows.zh: 发条走尽的表仍然是一只表，还可以重新上弦。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: An old watch, by contrast, becomes so worn and unreliable that it eventually is not worth mending.
rows.zh: 相比之下，旧表会磨损得如此严重、运行如此不可靠，最终不值得再修。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But a watch could never repair itself—it does not consist of living parts, only of metal, which wears away by friction.
rows.zh: 不过，表永远不会自我修复；它不是由活的部件组成的，而只是由金属构成，金属会因摩擦而磨损。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We could, at one time, repair ourselves—well enough, at least, to overcome all but the most instantly fatal illnesses and accidents.
rows.zh: 我们曾经能够自我修复，至少修复能力足以克服除了那些极其迅速致命的疾病和意外之外的一切病伤。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Between twelve and eighty years we gradually lose this power; an illness which at twelve would knock us over, at eighty can knock us out, and into our grave.
rows.zh: 从十二岁到八十岁，我们渐渐失去这种能力；一种病在十二岁时只会使我们病倒，到了八十岁却可能把我们彻底击垮，送进坟墓。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If we could stay as vigorous as we are at twelve, it would take about 700 years for half of us to die, and another 700 for the survivors to be reduced by half again.
rows.zh: 假如我们能一直保持十二岁时的旺盛活力，那么大约要经过七百年，我们当中才会有一半人死去；再过七百年，幸存者才会再减少一半。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 后接动词原形，表示预期会发生但截至目前还未发生。
usage.example: It has yet to reach its full size and strength, and its owner his or her full intelligence; but at this age the likelihood of death is least.
usage.exampleZh: 身体的大小与力量尚未完全长成，人的智力也尚未充分发展，但这个年龄死亡的可能性最低。

usage.note: die of 后接死亡原因；保留原文引号，表示对这一惯常说法的引用。
usage.example: It is one of the most unpleasant discoveries which we all make that we must decline in this way, that if we escape wars, accidents and diseases we shall eventually ‘die of old age’, and that this happens at a rate which differs little from person to person, so that there are heavy odds in favour of our dying between the ages of sixty-five and eighty.
usage.exampleZh: 我们都会发现一个极其令人不快的事实：自己必定会这样衰退，即使躲过战争、意外和疾病，最终也会“老死”；而这种过程的速度在人与人之间相差很小，因此我们很有可能在六十五岁到八十岁之间去世。

usage.meaning: 按事物本性；自然而然地
usage.note: 表示认为某结果出于事物固有规律。
usage.example: They have also assumed that all animals, and probably other organisms such as trees, or even the universe itself, must in the nature of things ‘wear out’.
usage.exampleZh: 人们也以为，一切动物，或许还有树木等其他生物，甚至宇宙本身，都必然会依事物的本性而“耗损殆尽”。

usage.note: 主语是消耗者，of 后接能量、资源等。
usage.example: Most animals we commonly observe do in fact age as we do, if given the chance to live long enough; and mechanical systems like a wound watch, or the sun, do in fact run out of energy in accordance with the second law of thermodynamics (whether the whole universe does so is a moot point at present).
usage.exampleZh: 我们通常见到的大多数动物，如果有机会活得足够长，确实也像我们一样衰老；上了发条的表或太阳这样的机械性系统，也确实会依照热力学第二定律耗尽能量（整个宇宙是否如此，目前仍有争议）。

usage.note: moot 表示可争论、尚无定论，并非已经证实。
usage.example: Most animals we commonly observe do in fact age as we do, if given the chance to live long enough; and mechanical systems like a wound watch, or the sun, do in fact run out of energy in accordance with the second law of thermodynamics (whether the whole universe does so is a moot point at present).
usage.exampleZh: 我们通常见到的大多数动物，如果有机会活得足够长，确实也像我们一样衰老；上了发条的表或太阳这样的机械性系统，也确实会依照热力学第二定律耗尽能量（整个宇宙是否如此，目前仍有争议）。

rows.en: Contamination of water supplies is usually due to poor sanitation close to water sources, sewage disposal into the sources themselves, leakage of sewage into distribution systems or contamination with industrial or farm waste.
rows.zh: 供水受到污染，通常是因为水源附近卫生条件差、污水直接排入水源、污水渗漏进输配水系统，或被工业和农业废弃物污染。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Even if a piped water supply is safe at its source, it is not always safe by the time it reaches the tap.
rows.zh: 即使管道供水在源头是安全的，到达水龙头时也未必仍然安全。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Intermittent tap-water supplies should be regarded as particularly suspect.
rows.zh: 供水时断时续的自来水尤其应被视为可疑。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Travellers on short trips to areas with water supplies of uncertain quality should avoid drinking tap-water, or untreated water from any other source.
rows.zh: 短期前往水质不确定地区的旅行者，应避免饮用自来水，也不要喝任何其他来源的未经处理的水。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is best to keep to hot drinks, bottled or canned drinks of well-known brand names—international standards of water treatment are usually followed at bottling plants.
rows.zh: 最好只喝热饮和知名品牌的瓶装或罐装饮料，因为装瓶厂通常遵循国际水处理标准。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Carbonated drinks are acidic, and slightly safer.
rows.zh: 碳酸饮料呈酸性，稍微安全一些。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Make sure that all bottles are opened in your presence, and that their rims are clean and dry.
rows.zh: 要确保所有瓶子都当着你的面打开，而且瓶口清洁、干燥。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Boiling is always a good way of treating water.
rows.zh: 把水煮沸始终是一种很好的处理办法。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Some hotels supply boiled water on request and this can be used for drinking, or for brushing teeth.
rows.zh: 有些旅馆可应要求提供开水，这些水可用于饮用或刷牙。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Portable boiling elements that can boil small quantities of water are useful when the right voltage of electricity is available.
rows.zh: 如果能获得电压合适的电源，可煮沸少量水的便携式加热器很有用。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Refuse politely any cold drink from an unknown source.
rows.zh: 对于任何来源不明的冷饮，都应礼貌地谢绝。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Ice is only as safe as the water from which it is made, and should not be put in drinks unless it is known to be safe.
rows.zh: 冰的安全程度只与制冰用水相当，除非确定安全，否则不应放进饮料里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Drinks can be cooled by placing them on ice rather than adding ice to them.
rows.zh: 可以把饮料放在冰上降温，而不是把冰加进饮料。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Alcohol may be a medical disinfectant, but should not be relied upon to sterilize water.
rows.zh: 酒精虽可作医用消毒剂，却不应被用来保证水的灭菌。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Ethanol is more effective at a concentration of 50-70 per cent; below 20 per cent, its bactericidal action is negligible.
rows.zh: 乙醇在浓度为百分之五十至七十时更有效；低于百分之二十时，其杀菌作用微乎其微。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Spirits labelled 95 proof contain only about 47 per cent alcohol.
rows.zh: 标为九十五 proof 的烈酒，酒精含量其实只有约百分之四十七。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Beware of methylated alcohol, which is very poisonous, and should never be added to drinking water.
rows.zh: 要提防变性酒精，它毒性很强，绝不能加入饮用水中。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If no other safe water supply can be obtained, tap water that is too hot to touch can be left to cool and is generally safe to drink.
rows.zh: 如果没有其他安全水源，可以把烫得不能碰的自来水放凉，一般可以安全饮用。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Those planning a trip to remote areas, or intending to live in countries where drinking water is not readily available, should know about the various possible methods for making water safe.
rows.zh: 计划去偏远地区旅行，或准备在不容易获得饮用水的国家居住的人，应该了解使水变得安全的各种可行方法。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: due to 后接名词性原因；usually 限定为通常情况。
usage.example: Contamination of water supplies is usually due to poor sanitation close to water sources, sewage disposal into the sources themselves, leakage of sewage into distribution systems or contamination with industrial or farm waste.
usage.exampleZh: 供水受到污染，通常是因为水源附近卫生条件差、污水直接排入水源、污水渗漏进输配水系统，或被工业和农业废弃物污染。

usage.note: 此处建议将饮品选择限制在列出的类别。
usage.example: It is best to keep to hot drinks, bottled or canned drinks of well-known brand names—international standards of water treatment are usually followed at bottling plants.
usage.exampleZh: 最好只喝热饮和知名品牌的瓶装或罐装饮料，因为装瓶厂通常遵循国际水处理标准。

usage.note: 指有人在场并能看到事情发生。
usage.example: Make sure that all bottles are opened in your presence, and that their rims are clean and dry.
usage.exampleZh: 要确保所有瓶子都当着你的面打开，而且瓶口清洁、干燥。

usage.note: 表示提出要求后即可提供服务，不表示自动供应。
usage.example: Some hotels supply boiled water on request and this can be used for drinking, or for brushing teeth.
usage.exampleZh: 有些旅馆可应要求提供开水，这些水可用于饮用或刷牙。

usage.note: 常用于提示危险，of 后接需警惕的事物。
usage.example: Beware of methylated alcohol, which is very poisonous, and should never be added to drinking water.
usage.exampleZh: 要提防变性酒精，它毒性很强，绝不能加入饮用水中。

rows.en: I have known very few writers, but those I have known, and whom I respect, confess at once that they have little idea where they are going when they first set pen to paper.
rows.zh: 我认识的作家很少，但那些我认识而且尊敬的作家，都会坦然承认：刚落笔时，他们几乎不知道自己将写向何处。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They have a character, perhaps two; they are in that condition of eager discomfort which passes for inspiration; all admit radical changes of destination once the journey has begun; one, to my certain knowledge, spent nine months on a novel about Kashmir, then reset the whole thing in the Scottish Highlands.
rows.zh: 他们也许有一个人物，或两个人物；他们处于一种迫切而不安、被称作灵感的状态；他们都承认，开始创作之后，原定的方向会出现根本改变；其中一位，据我确切所知，花了九个月写一部以克什米尔为背景的小说，后来又把整部作品的背景改设在苏格兰高地。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I never heard of anyone making a ‘skeleton’, as we were taught at school.
rows.zh: 我从没听说谁会像我们在学校里所学的那样，先列一个“骨架”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In the breaking and remaking, in the timing, interweaving, beginning afresh, the writer comes to discern things in his material which were not consciously in his mind when he began.
rows.zh: 在打破与重塑、安排节奏、穿插情节、重新开始的过程中，作家逐渐辨认出素材中一些起初并未清楚意识到的东西。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This organic process, often leading to moments of extraordinary self-discovery, is of an indescribable fascination.
rows.zh: 这个有机发展的过程，常常使人获得非同寻常的自我发现，其魅力无法形容。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A blurred image appears; he adds a brushstroke and another, and it is gone; but something was there, and he will not rest till he has captured it.
rows.zh: 一个模糊的形象浮现了；他添上一笔，再添一笔，它却消失了；可那里确实曾有过什么，而他不捕捉到它便不会罢休。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Sometimes the yeast within a writer outlives a book he has written.
rows.zh: 有时，作家内心发酵的创作冲动，在一本书写完之后还会继续存在。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I have heard of writers who read nothing but their own books; like adolescents they stand before the mirror, and still cannot fathom the exact outline of the vision before them.
rows.zh: 我听说过一些作家，他们除了自己的书什么也不读；他们像青少年一样站在镜前，却仍然摸不清眼前影像的准确轮廓。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For the same reason, writers talk interminably about their own books, winkling out hidden meanings, super-imposing new ones, begging response from those around them.
rows.zh: 出于同样的原因，作家会没完没了地谈论自己的书，挖掘隐藏的意义，再叠加新的意义，恳求周围人给予回应。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Of course a writer doing this is misunderstood: he might as well try to explain a crime or a love affair.
rows.zh: 当然，作家这样做会被人误解；他还不如试着去解释一桩罪行或一场恋情。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He is also, incidentally, an unforgivable bore.
rows.zh: 顺便说一句，他也会变成一个让人无法原谅的讨厌鬼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This temptation to cover the distance between himself and the reader, to study his image in the sight of those who do not know him, can be his undoing: he has begun to write to please.
rows.zh: 想要消除自己与读者之间的距离，想从那些不了解自己的人的眼中研究自己的形象，这种诱惑可能毁掉他：他已开始为了取悦别人而写作。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A young English writer made the pertinent observation a year or two back that the talent goes into the first draft, and the art into the drafts that follow.
rows.zh: 一两年前，一位年轻的英国作家作过一个贴切的观察：才华倾注在初稿里，艺术则体现在之后一遍遍的改稿中。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For this reason also the writer, like any other artist, has no resting place, no crowd or movement in which he may take comfort, no judgment from outside which can replace the judgment from within.
rows.zh: 也是因为这个缘故，作家像任何其他艺术家一样，没有安歇之所，没有可从中寻得慰藉的人群或运动，也没有任何外来的判断能取代内心的判断。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A writer makes order out of the anarchy of his heart; he submits himself to a more ruthless discipline than any critic dreamed of, and when he flirts with fame, he is taking time off from living with himself, from the search for what his world contains at its inmost point.
rows.zh: 作家从自己内心的混乱中创造秩序；他让自己服从比任何评论家所能想象的都更严酷的约束；而当他向名声调情时，不过是暂时离开与自己相处的生活，暂时放下对自己世界最深处究竟包含什么的探索。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 固定表达，常用于谈写作起点。
usage.example: I have known very few writers, but those I have known, and whom I respect, confess at once that they have little idea where they are going when they first set pen to paper.
usage.exampleZh: 我认识的作家很少，但那些我认识而且尊敬的作家，都会坦然承认：刚落笔时，他们几乎不知道自己将写向何处。

usage.note: 常暗示名不副实或说话者有所保留，此处形容所谓灵感。
usage.example: They have a character, perhaps two; they are in that condition of eager discomfort which passes for inspiration; all admit radical changes of destination once the journey has begun; one, to my certain knowledge, spent nine months on a novel about Kashmir, then reset the whole thing in the Scottish Highlands.
usage.exampleZh: 他们也许有一个人物，或两个人物；他们处于一种迫切而不安、被称作灵感的状态；他们都承认，开始创作之后，原定的方向会出现根本改变；其中一位，据我确切所知，花了九个月写一部以克什米尔为背景的小说，后来又把整部作品的背景改设在苏格兰高地。

usage.note: 后接动词原形，此处用另一个同样难以说清的事情作反讽。
usage.example: Of course a writer doing this is misunderstood: he might as well try to explain a crime or a love affair.
usage.exampleZh: 当然，作家这样做会被人误解；他还不如试着去解释一桩罪行或一场恋情。

usage.note: 常搭配 in 或 from，引出慰藉来源；原文用 in which。
usage.example: For this reason also the writer, like any other artist, has no resting place, no crowd or movement in which he may take comfort, no judgment from outside which can replace the judgment from within.
usage.exampleZh: 也是因为这个缘故，作家像任何其他艺术家一样，没有安歇之所，没有可从中寻得慰藉的人群或运动，也没有任何外来的判断能取代内心的判断。

usage.note: from 后接名词或动名词，表示暂离平日持续进行的活动。
usage.example: A writer makes order out of the anarchy of his heart; he submits himself to a more ruthless discipline than any critic dreamed of, and when he flirts with fame, he is taking time off from living with himself, from the search for what his world contains at its inmost point.
usage.exampleZh: 作家从自己内心的混乱中创造秩序；他让自己服从比任何评论家所能想象的都更严酷的约束；而当他向名声调情时，不过是暂时离开与自己相处的生活，暂时放下对自己世界最深处究竟包含什么的探索。

lessons.title: Waves

rows.en: Waves are the children of the struggle between ocean and atmosphere, the ongoing signatures of infinity.
rows.zh: 波浪是海洋与大气搏斗的产物，是无穷世界不断写下的印记。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Rays from the sun excite and energize the atmosphere of the earth, awakening it to flow, to movement, to rhythm, to life.
rows.zh: 太阳的光芒激发地球的大气，赋予它能量，使它苏醒，开始流动，开始运动，获得节奏，获得生命。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The wind then speaks the message of the sun to the sea and the sea transmits it on through waves—an ancient, exquisite, powerful message.
rows.zh: 接着，风把太阳的信息诉说给大海，大海又通过波浪继续传递它——一个古老、精妙而强有力的信息。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: These ocean waves are among the earth’s most complicated natural phenomena.
rows.zh: 这些海浪是地球上最复杂的自然现象之一。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The basic features include a crest (the highest point of the wave), a trough (the lowest point), a height (the vertical distance from the trough to the crest), a wave length (the horizontal distance between two wave crests), and a period (which is the time it takes a wave crest to travel one wave length).
rows.zh: 它们的基本特征包括波峰（波浪的最高点）、波谷（最低点）、波高（波谷到波峰的垂直距离）、波长（两个波峰间的水平距离）以及周期（一个波峰前进一个波长所需的时间）。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Although an ocean wave gives the impression of a wall of water moving in your direction, in actuality waves move through the water leaving the water about where it was.
rows.zh: 海浪虽然给人一种水墙迎面移来的印象，但实际上，波是在水中传播，水却大致留在原处。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If the water was moving with the wave, the ocean and everything on it would be racing in to the shore with obviously catastrophic results.
rows.zh: 如果水也随着波浪移动，那么海洋以及海上的一切都会向岸边狂奔，结果显然会是灾难性的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: An ocean wave passing through deep water causes a particle on the surface to move in a roughly circular orbit, drawing the particle first towards the advancing wave, then up into the wave, then forward with it and then—as the wave leaves the particles behind—back to its starting point again.
rows.zh: 海浪通过深水时，会使水面上的一个质点沿大致呈圆形的轨道运动：先把它拉向正在前进的波浪，再向上带入波中，接着让它随波向前，随后当波浪把质点留在身后时，又使它回到起点。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: From both maturity to death, a wave is subject to the same laws as any other ‘living’ thing.
rows.zh: 从成熟到消亡，波浪与任何其他“活的”事物一样，都受同样的规律支配。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For a time it assumes a miraculous individuality that, in the end, is reabsorbed into the great ocean of life.
rows.zh: 它暂时呈现出一种奇妙的个体性，最终这种个体性又被重新吸收到生命的大海之中。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The undulating waves of the open sea are generated by three natural causes: wind, earth movements or tremors, and the gravitational pull of the moon and the sun.
rows.zh: 外海起伏的波浪由三种自然原因产生：风、地球的运动或震颤，以及月球和太阳的引力。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Once waves have been generated, gravity is the force that drives them in a continual attempt to restore the ocean surface to a flat plain.
rows.zh: 波浪一旦形成，重力便成为驱动它们的力量，不断试图把海面恢复成平坦的面。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: of 后接名词性内容，也可用 give the impression that 接从句。
usage.example: Although an ocean wave gives the impression of a wall of water moving in your direction, in actuality waves move through the water leaving the water about where it was.
usage.exampleZh: 海浪虽然给人一种水墙迎面移来的印象，但实际上，波是在水中传播，水却大致留在原处。

usage.note: 用于说明真实机制与外观印象的差别。
usage.example: Although an ocean wave gives the impression of a wall of water moving in your direction, in actuality waves move through the water leaving the water about where it was.
usage.exampleZh: 海浪虽然给人一种水墙迎面移来的印象，但实际上，波是在水中传播，水却大致留在原处。

usage.note: 可指在空间上经过并离开，代词或名词宾语可放在中间。
usage.example: An ocean wave passing through deep water causes a particle on the surface to move in a roughly circular orbit, drawing the particle first towards the advancing wave, then up into the wave, then forward with it and then—as the wave leaves the particles behind—back to its starting point again.
usage.exampleZh: 海浪通过深水时，会使水面上的一个质点沿大致呈圆形的轨道运动：先把它拉向正在前进的波浪，再向上带入波中，接着让它随波向前，随后当波浪把质点留在身后时，又使它回到起点。

usage.note: to 后接规律、限制或变化，说明无法摆脱其作用。
usage.example: From both maturity to death, a wave is subject to the same laws as any other ‘living’ thing.
usage.exampleZh: 从成熟到消亡，波浪与任何其他“活的”事物一样，都受同样的规律支配。

usage.note: 表示状态持续一段时间，未说明具体长度。
usage.example: For a time it assumes a miraculous individuality that, in the end, is reabsorbed into the great ocean of life.
usage.exampleZh: 它暂时呈现出一种奇妙的个体性，最终这种个体性又被重新吸收到生命的大海之中。

translationNotes: 英文“From both maturity to death”疑有讹字，保留原文；中文依本段关于波浪生命历程的语境理解为“从成熟到消亡”。

rows.en: Two main techniques have been used for training elephants, which we may call respectively the tough and the gentle.
rows.zh: 训练大象主要采用过两种方法，我们可以分别称为强硬法和温和法。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The former method simply consists of setting an elephant to work and beating him until he does what is expected of him.
rows.zh: 前一种方法很简单，就是让大象干活，然后一直打，直到它按要求做。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Apart from any moral considerations this is a stupid method of training, for it produces a resentful animal who at a later stage may well turn man-killer.
rows.zh: 即使不谈任何道德问题，这也是愚蠢的训练方法，因为这样训出的动物心怀怨恨，日后很可能变成杀人的凶手。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The gentle method requires more patience in the early stages, but produces a cheerful, good-tempered elephant who will give many years of loyal service.
rows.zh: 温和法在初期需要更多耐心，却能训出性情愉快、脾气温顺的大象，多年忠实地为人服务。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The first essential in elephant training is to assign to the animal a single mahout who will be entirely responsible for the job.
rows.zh: 驯象的首要条件，是为每头象指定一名驯象人，由他全权负责这项工作。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Elephants like to have one master just as dogs do, and are capable of a considerable degree of personal affection.
rows.zh: 大象和狗一样，喜欢只有一个主人，而且能产生相当深厚的个人感情。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There are even stories of half-trained elephant calves who have refused to feed and pined to death when by some unavoidable circumstance they have been deprived of their own trainer.
rows.zh: 甚至还有这样的故事：有些只训了一半的幼象，因为某种无法避免的情况而失去自己的驯象人，便拒绝进食，憔悴而死。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Such extreme cases must probably be taken with a grain of salt, but they do underline the general principle that the relationship between elephant and mahout is the key to successful training.
rows.zh: 这种极端的事例恐怕不可全信，但它们确实强调了一条普遍原则：大象和驯象人的关系，是成功训练的关键。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The most economical age to capture an elephant for training is between fifteen and twenty years, for it is then almost ready to undertake heavy work and can begin to earn its keep straight away.
rows.zh: 捕捉大象来训练，最经济的年龄是十五岁到二十岁，因为此时它几乎已能承担重活，马上就能开始干活抵偿饲养费用。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But animals of this age do not easily become subservient to man, and a very firm hand must be employed in the early stages.
rows.zh: 不过，这个年龄的动物不容易顺从人，因此训练初期必须用十分坚决的手段。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The captive elephant, still roped to a tree, plunges and screams every time a man approaches, and for several days will probably refuse all food through anger and fear.
rows.zh: 被捕的大象仍拴在树上，每当有人走近，就会猛冲尖叫，而且可能因愤怒和恐惧，连续几天拒绝一切食物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Sometimes a tame elephant is tethered nearby to give the wild one confidence, and in most cases the captive gradually quietens down and begins to accept its food.
rows.zh: 有时，人们会把一头驯熟的象拴在附近，让野象安心；多数情况下，被捕的大象会逐渐平静，开始接受食物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The next stage is to get the elephant to the training establishment, a ticklish business which is achieved with the aid of two tame elephants roped to the captive on either side.
rows.zh: 下一步是把大象带到训练场，这是一件棘手的事，须把两头驯象分别用绳子拴在它两侧，借助它们才办得到。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When several elephants are being trained at one time, it is customary for the new arrival to be placed between the stalls of two captives whose training is already well advanced.
rows.zh: 同时训练几头大象时，通常会把新来的象安置在两头训练已相当有进展的被捕大象的栏舍之间。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is then left completely undisturbed with plenty of food and water so that it can absorb the atmosphere of its new home and see that nothing particularly alarming is happening to its companions.
rows.zh: 然后给它充足的食物和水，完全不去打扰，让它慢慢适应新家的气氛，看到同伴并没有遇到什么特别可怕的事。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When it is eating normally, its own training begins.
rows.zh: 等它能正常进食，就开始训练它。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The trainer stands in front of the elephant holding a long stick with a sharp metal point.
rows.zh: 驯象人手持一根末端装着尖金属头的长棍，站到大象面前。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Two assistants, mounted on tame elephants, control the captive from either side, while others rub their hands over his skin to the accompaniment of a monotonous and soothing chant.
rows.zh: 两名助手骑在驯象背上，从两侧控制被捕的大象，其他人则用手摩擦它的皮肤，并伴以单调而舒缓的吟唱。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This is supposed to induce pleasurable sensations in the elephant, and its effects are reinforced by the use of endearing epithets, such as ‘ho!
rows.zh: 据说这样能使大象产生愉悦的感觉；人们还会用亲昵的称呼加强效果，例如：“嗬！
rows.speaker: 旁白 / 驯象人

rows.en: my son’, or ‘ho!
rows.zh: 我的孩子”，或“嗬！
rows.speaker: 驯象人

rows.en: my father’, or ‘my mother’, according to the age and sex of the captive.
rows.zh: 我的父亲”，或“我的母亲”，具体称呼取决于被捕大象的年龄和性别。
rows.speaker: 驯象人 / 旁白

rows.en: The elephant is not immediately susceptible to such blandishments, however, and usually lashes fiercely with its trunk in all directions.
rows.zh: 然而，大象并不会立刻接受这些甜言蜜语，通常会向各个方向猛烈甩动鼻子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: These movements are controlled by the trainer with the metal-pointed stick, and the trunk eventually becomes so sore that the elephant curls it up and seldom afterwards uses it for offensive purposes.
rows.zh: 驯象人用那根带金属尖头的棍子制止这些动作，最后象鼻疼痛得厉害，大象便把它卷起来，往后也很少再用它攻击了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 此处先排除道德角度，再从训练成效批评强硬方法。

usage.exampleZh: 下一步是把大象带到训练场，这是一件棘手的事，须把两头驯象分别用绳子拴在它两侧，借助它们才办得到。

rows.en: An earthquake comes like a thief in the night, without warning.
rows.zh: 地震就像夜里的窃贼，毫无预警地到来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was necessary, therefore, to invent instruments that neither slumbered nor slept.
rows.zh: 因此，有必要发明既不打盹、也不睡觉的仪器。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Some devices were quite simple.
rows.zh: 有些装置很简单。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: One, for instance, consisted of rods of various lengths and thicknesses which would stand up on end like ninepins.
rows.zh: 例如有一种，是把长短、粗细不同的杆子，像九柱戏的木柱一样竖立起来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When a shock came, it shook the rigid table upon which these stood.
rows.zh: 震动到来时，便摇动这些杆子所立的坚硬桌面。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If it were gentle, only the more unstable rods fell.
rows.zh: 如果震动轻微，只有较不稳定的杆子会倒。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If it were severe, they all fell.
rows.zh: 如果震动强烈，杆子就全倒了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Thus the rods, by falling, and by the direction in which they fell, recorded for the slumbering scientist the strength of a shock that was too weak to waken him, and the direction from which it came.
rows.zh: 这样，杆子通过是否倒下以及倒下的方向，为熟睡中的科学家记录下那种不足以把他震醒的震动的强度和来向。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But instruments far more delicate than that were needed if any really serious advance was to be made.
rows.zh: 但若要取得真正重大的进展，就需要比这精密得多的仪器。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The ideal to be aimed at was to devise an instrument that could record with a pen on paper, the movements of the ground or of the table as the quake passed by.
rows.zh: 应当追求的理想，是设计出一种仪器，能在地震经过时，用笔在纸上记录地面或桌面的运动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: While I write my pen moves, but the paper keeps still.
rows.zh: 我写字时，笔在动，纸却静止不动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: With practice, no doubt, I could in time learn to write by holding the pen still while the paper moved.
rows.zh: 只要练习，毫无疑问，我最终也能学会让笔保持不动、让纸移动来写字。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: That sounds a silly suggestion, but that was precisely the idea adopted in some of the early instruments (seismometers) for recording earthquake waves.
rows.zh: 这听起来是个愚蠢的建议，但早期某些记录地震波的仪器，也就是地震仪，采用的恰恰就是这个想法。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But when table, penholder and paper are all moving, how is it possible to write legibly?
rows.zh: 可是，当桌子、笔架和纸都在移动时，怎么可能把字写清楚呢？
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The key to a solution of that problem lay in an everyday observation.
rows.zh: 解决这个问题的关键，藏在一个日常观察中。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Why does a person standing in a bus or train tend to fall when a sudden start is made?
rows.zh: 为什么公共汽车或火车突然启动时，站在车上的人容易摔倒？
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is because his feet move on, but his head stays still.
rows.zh: 因为他的脚向前移动了，头却仍停留在原处。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A simple experiment will help us a little further.
rows.zh: 一个简单实验会帮助我们再理解得深入一点。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Tie a heavy weight at the end of a long piece of string.
rows.zh: 在一根长绳的一端拴一个重物。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: With the hand held high in the air, hold the string so that the weight nearly touches the ground.
rows.zh: 把手高举在空中，握住绳子，使重物几乎碰到地面。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Now move the hand to and fro and around but not up and down.
rows.zh: 现在让手来回移动或转圈，但不要上下移动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It will be found that the weight moves but slightly or not at all.
rows.zh: 你会发现，重物只动一点点，甚至完全不动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Imagine a pen attached to the weight in such a way that its point rests upon a piece of paper on the floor.
rows.zh: 想象把一支笔装在重物上，使笔尖搁在地面的一张纸上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Imagine an earthquake shock shaking the floor, the paper, you and your hand.
rows.zh: 再想象一阵地震震动了地板、纸、你和你的手。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In the midst of all this movement, the weight and the pen would be still.
rows.zh: 在这一片运动之中，重物和笔却会静止不动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But as the paper moved from side to side under the pen point, its movement would be recorded in ink upon its surface.
rows.zh: 但当纸在笔尖下面左右移动时，它的运动就会被墨水记录在纸面上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was upon this principle that the first instruments were made, but the paper was wrapped round a drum which rotated slowly.
rows.zh: 最早的仪器就是根据这一原理制造的，不过纸是包在一个缓慢转动的圆筒上的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As long as all was still, the pen drew a straight line, but while the drum was being shaken, the line that the pen was drawing wriggled from side to side.
rows.zh: 只要一切静止，笔就画出直线；而圆筒受到摇动时，笔正在画的线便会左右弯曲。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The apparatus thus described, however, records only the horizontal component of the wave movement, which is, in fact, much more complicated.
rows.zh: 然而，上述仪器只能记录波动的水平分量；实际上，波动要复杂得多。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If we could actually see the path described by a particle, such as a sand grain in the rock, it would be more like that of a bluebottle buzzing round the room; it would be up and down, to and fro and from side to side.
rows.zh: 如果真能看见一个质点，例如岩石中的一粒沙，所描绘的运动轨迹，它会更像一只在屋里嗡嗡乱飞的绿头苍蝇；它会上下、前后、左右地运动。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Instruments have been devised and can be so placed that all three elements can be recorded in different graphs.
rows.zh: 人们已设计出仪器，并可通过适当安放，使这三个方向的分量都记录在不同的图线上。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When the instrument is situated at more than 700 miles from the earthquake centre, the graphic record shows three waves arriving one after the other at short intervals.
rows.zh: 仪器若位于距震中七百英里以外，图形记录会显示三种波以很短的间隔先后到达。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The first records the arrival of longitudinal vibrations.
rows.zh: 第一种记录纵向振动的到达。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The second marks the arrival of transverse vibrations which travel more slowly and arrive several minutes after the first.
rows.zh: 第二种标志着横向振动的到达；它传播较慢，比第一种晚几分钟到达。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: These two have travelled through the earth.
rows.zh: 这两种波都穿过了地球内部。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was from the study of these that so much was learnt about the interior of the earth.
rows.zh: 正是通过研究它们，人们才获得了许多关于地球内部的知识。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The third, or main wave, is the slowest and has travelled round the earth through the surface rocks.
rows.zh: 第三种波，或者说主波，最慢，它沿地球表面的岩石传播，绕地球而行。
rows.speaker: 旁白
