rows.en: We must conclude from the work of those who have studied the origin of life, that given a planet only approximately like our own, life is almost certain to start.
rows.zh: 根据生命起源研究者的工作，我们必须得出这样的结论：只要有一颗与地球大致相似的行星，生命几乎肯定会萌生。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Of all the planets in our own solar system, we are now pretty certain the Earth is the only one on which life can survive.
rows.zh: 在我们太阳系的所有行星中，如今我们相当确信，地球是唯一能让生命生存的星球。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Mars is too dry and poor in oxygen, Venus far too hot, and so is Mercury, and the outer planets have temperatures near absolute zero and hydrogen-dominated atmospheres.
rows.zh: 火星太干燥，氧气也太少；金星过热，水星也是如此；外侧行星的温度接近绝对零度，大气则以氢为主。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But other suns, stars as the astronomers call them, are bound to have planets like our own, and as the number of stars in the universe is so vast, this possibility becomes virtual certainty.
rows.zh: 但别的太阳，也就是天文学家所说的恒星，必然会有像地球这样的行星；宇宙中的恒星数量如此巨大，这种可能性实际上便成了必然。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There are one hundred thousand million stars in our own Milky Way alone, and then there are three thousand million other Milky Ways, or galaxies, in the universe.
rows.zh: 仅我们自己的银河系中就有一千亿颗恒星，宇宙里还有另外三十亿个银河系那样的星系。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: So the number of stars that we know exist is now estimated at about 300 million million million.
rows.zh: 因此，我们如今估计，已知存在的恒星总数约为三乘以十的二十次方颗。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Although perhaps only 1 per cent of the life that has started somewhere will develop into highly complex and intelligent patterns, so vast is the number of planets, that intelligent life is bound to be a natural part of the universe.
rows.zh: 在某处已经出现的生命中，虽然也许只有百分之一会发展成高度复杂而有智慧的形式，但行星数量如此庞大，智慧生命必然是宇宙中自然存在的一部分。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If then we are so certain that other intelligent life exists in the universe, why have we had no visitors from outer space yet?
rows.zh: 那么，既然我们如此确信宇宙中存在其他智慧生命，为什么至今还没有外太空的访客呢？
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: First of all, they may have come to this planet of ours thousands or millions of years ago, and found our then prevailing primitive state completely uninteresting to their own advanced knowledge.
rows.zh: 首先，他们可能在几千年、几百万年前就来过我们这颗行星，却发现当时这里的原始状态，对于掌握着先进知识的他们来说，完全没有趣味。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Professor Ronald Bracewell, a leading American radio astronomer, argued in Nature that such a superior civilization, on a visit to our own solar system, may have left an automatic messenger behind to await the possible awakening of an advanced civilization.
rows.zh: 美国杰出的射电天文学家罗纳德·布雷斯韦尔教授在《自然》杂志上论述过：这种先进文明造访我们的太阳系时，可能留下了一个自动信使，等待一个先进文明可能出现的觉醒。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Such a messenger, receiving our radio and television signals, might well re-transmit them back to its home-planet, although what impression any other civilization would thus get from us is best left unsaid.
rows.zh: 这样的信使收到我们的广播和电视信号后，很可能把它们转发回自己的母星；不过，其他文明由此会对我们形成什么印象，还是不说为妙。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But here we come up against the most difficult of all obstacles to contact with people on other planets —the astronomical distances which separate us.
rows.zh: 然而，在这里我们遇到了与其他行星上的人接触的最大障碍：将我们分隔开来的天文距离。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As a reasonable guess, they might, on an average, be 100 light years away.
rows.zh: 作一个合理估计，他们离我们平均可能有一百光年。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: (A light year is the distance which light travels at 186,000 miles per second in one year, namely 6 million million miles.)
rows.zh: （一光年是光以每秒十八万六千英里的速度，在一年中所行进的距离，即六万亿英里。）
rows.speaker: 说明

rows.en: Radio waves also travel at the speed of light, and assuming such an automatic messenger picked up our first broadcasts of the 1920’s, the message to its home planet is barely halfway there.
rows.zh: 无线电波也以光速传播；假定这样一个自动信使接收到了我们二十世纪二十年代最早的广播，那么传向它母星的信息，如今还勉强只走了一半路程。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Similarly, our own present primitive chemical rockets, though good enough to orbit men, have no chance of transporting us to the nearest other star, four light years away, let alone distances of tens or hundreds of light years.
rows.zh: 同样，我们目前这种原始的化学火箭，虽然足以把人送入轨道，却根本不可能把我们运送到四光年外最近的另一颗恒星，更不用说几十或几百光年的距离了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Fortunately, there is a ‘uniquely rational way’ for us to communicate with other intelligent beings, as Walter Sullivan has put it in his excellent book, We Are not Alone.
rows.zh: 幸运的是，正如沃尔特·沙利文在其出色的著作《我们并不孤独》中所说，我们与其他智慧生命交流，有一种“独一无二的合理方式”。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This depends on the precise radio frequency of the 21-cm wavelength, or 1420 megacycles per second.
rows.zh: 这种方式依靠的是二十一厘米波长所对应的精确无线电频率，也就是每秒一千四百二十兆周。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is the natural frequency of emission of the hydrogen atoms in space and was discovered by us in 1951; it must be known to any kind of radio astronomer in the universe.
rows.zh: 这是太空中氢原子发射的自然频率，我们于一九五一年发现了它；宇宙中任何射电天文学家都必定知道它。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Once the existence of this wave-length had been discovered, it was not long before its use as the uniquely recognizable broadcasting frequency for interstellar communication was suggested.
rows.zh: 这种波长一经发现，没过多久就有人提出，把它用作星际通信中可被独一识别的广播频率。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Without something of this kind, searching for intelligences on other planets would be like trying to meet a friend in London without a pre-arranged rendezvous and absurdly wandering the streets in the hope of a chance encounter.
rows.zh: 如果没有这类约定，搜寻其他行星上的智慧生命，就像想在伦敦见一个朋友，却不事先约定见面地点，只是荒唐地在街头游荡，盼着偶然相遇。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 表达说话者对结果的高度确信，后接动词原形。
usage.example: But other suns, stars as the astronomers call them, are bound to have planets like our own, and as the number of stars in the universe is so vast, this possibility becomes virtual certainty.
usage.exampleZh: 但别的太阳，也就是天文学家所说的恒星，必然会有像地球这样的行星；宇宙中的恒星数量如此巨大，这种可能性实际上便成了必然。

usage.note: leave something unsaid 表示不把话说出；此处有讽刺意味。
usage.example: Such a messenger, receiving our radio and television signals, might well re-transmit them back to its home-planet, although what impression any other civilization would thus get from us is best left unsaid.
usage.exampleZh: 这样的信使收到我们的广播和电视信号后，很可能把它们转发回自己的母星；不过，其他文明由此会对我们形成什么印象，还是不说为妙。

usage.note: 常接困难、阻力或难以解决的问题。
usage.example: But here we come up against the most difficult of all obstacles to contact with people on other planets —the astronomical distances which separate us.
usage.exampleZh: 然而，在这里我们遇到了与其他行星上的人接触的最大障碍：将我们分隔开来的天文距离。

usage.note: 从较低要求都做不到，推到更高要求更无法做到。
usage.example: Similarly, our own present primitive chemical rockets, though good enough to orbit men, have no chance of transporting us to the nearest other star, four light years away, let alone distances of tens or hundreds of light years.
usage.exampleZh: 同样，我们目前这种原始的化学火箭，虽然足以把人送入轨道，却根本不可能把我们运送到四光年外最近的另一颗恒星，更不用说几十或几百光年的距离了。

usage.note: of 后接名词或动名词，说明做事时所盼望的结果。
usage.example: Without something of this kind, searching for intelligences on other planets would be like trying to meet a friend in London without a pre-arranged rendezvous and absurdly wandering the streets in the hope of a chance encounter.
usage.exampleZh: 如果没有这类约定，搜寻其他行星上的智慧生命，就像想在伦敦见一个朋友，却不事先约定见面地点，只是荒唐地在街头游荡，盼着偶然相遇。

rows.en: Custom has not commonly been regarded as a subject of any great moment.
rows.zh: 习俗通常并不被视为一个多么重要的研究课题。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The inner workings of our own brains we feel to be uniquely worthy of investigation, but custom, we have a way of thinking, is behaviour at its most commonplace.
rows.zh: 我们觉得自己大脑的内部运作格外值得研究，却习惯认为习俗不过是最平常不过的行为。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As a matter of fact, it is the other way around.
rows.zh: 事实上，情况恰恰相反。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Traditional custom, taken the world over, is a mass of detailed behaviour more astonishing than what any one person can ever evolve in individual actions, no matter how aberrant.
rows.zh: 从全世界来看，传统习俗是一整套细致繁多的行为，比任何个人凭一己行动所能发展出的行为都更令人惊异，无论这个人的举动多么离经叛道。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Yet that is a rather trivial aspect of the matter.
rows.zh: 然而，这还只是事情一个相当次要的方面。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The fact of first-rate importance is the predominant role that custom plays in experience and in belief, and the very great varieties it may manifest.
rows.zh: 最为重要的事实，是习俗在经验和信念中所起的主导作用，以及它可能表现出的极其丰富的差异。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: No man ever looks at the world with pristine eyes.
rows.zh: 从来没有人用毫无成见的眼光看世界。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: He sees it edited by a definite set of customs and institutions and ways of thinking.
rows.zh: 他所看到的世界，已经过一套特定的习俗、制度和思维方式的编排。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Even in his philosophical probings he cannot go behind these stereotypes: his very concepts of the true and the false will still have reference to his particular traditional customs.
rows.zh: 即使进行哲学探索，他也无法越出这些定式：连他对真与假的概念，也仍然关联着他所属的特定传统习俗。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: John Dewey has said in all seriousness that the part played by custom in shaping the behaviour of the individual, as against any way in which he can affect traditional custom, is as the proportion of the total vocabulary of his mother tongue against those words of his own baby talk that are taken up into the vernacular of his family.
rows.zh: 约翰·杜威曾十分严肃地说，习俗对塑造个人行为的影响，与个人以任何方式改变传统习俗的影响相比，其比例就像他母语的全部词汇量，与他幼儿时期所说、后来被家人纳入口头用语的那些话的数量之比。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: When one seriously studies the social orders that have had the opportunity to develop autonomously, the figure becomes no more than an exact and matter-of-fact observation.
rows.zh: 认真研究那些有机会自主发展的社会秩序后，就会发现，这个比喻其实只是准确、实事求是的观察。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The life history of the individual is first and foremost an accommodation to the patterns and standards traditionally handed down in his community.
rows.zh: 个人的生活史，首先而且最主要的，是不断适应其社区世代相传的模式和标准的过程。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: From the moment of his birth, the customs into which he is born shape his experience and behaviour.
rows.zh: 从出生那一刻起，他所处的习俗就塑造着他的经验和行为。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: By the time he can talk, he is the little creature of his culture, and by the time he is grown and able to take part in its activities, its habits are his habits, its beliefs his beliefs, its impossibilities his impossibilities.
rows.zh: 到能够说话时，他已成了自身文化塑造的小小产物；到长大并能参加其中活动时，这个文化的习惯就是他的习惯，它的信念就是他的信念，它认定不可能的事情，也就是他认定不可能的事情。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Every child that is born into his group will share them with him, and no child born into one on the opposite side of the globe can ever achieve the thousandth part.
rows.zh: 每个生在他这个群体中的孩子，都会同他分享这些；而出生在地球另一端某个群体的孩子，连其中千分之一也不可能获得。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There is no social problem it is more incumbent upon us to understand than this of the role of custom.
rows.zh: 没有哪个社会问题，比习俗的作用更是我们理应理解的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Until we are intelligent as to its laws and varieties, the main complicating facts of human life must remain unintelligible.
rows.zh: 在我们理解它的规律和差异之前，人类生活中那些使事情复杂化的主要事实，必然仍难以理解。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The study of custom can be profitable only after certain preliminary propositions have been accepted, and some of these propositions have been violently opposed.
rows.zh: 只有接受了某些前提，习俗研究才能有所收获；而其中一些前提曾遭到激烈反对。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In the first place, any scientific study requires that there be no preferential weighting of one or another of the items in the series it selects for its consideration.
rows.zh: 首先，任何科学研究都要求，对所选择考察的一系列对象，不应偏袒其中任何一项。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In all the less controversial fields, like the study of cacti or termites or the nature of nebulae, the necessary method of study is to group the relevant material and to take note of all possible variant forms and conditions.
rows.zh: 在所有争议较小的领域，例如研究仙人掌、白蚁或星云的性质时，必需的方法都是把有关材料归类，并留意一切可能的变异形式和条件。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In this way, we have learned all that we know of the laws of astronomy, or of the habits of the social insects, let us say.
rows.zh: 我们关于天文学规律，或者比如社会性昆虫习性的全部知识，都是这样得来的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is only in the study of man himself that the major social sciences have substituted the study of one local variation, that of Western civilization.
rows.zh: 只有在研究人类自身时，主要社会科学才把对某一种地方性变体——即西方文明——的研究，拿来代替对全体的研究。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Anthropology was by definition impossible, as long as these distinctions between ourselves and the primitive, ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan, held sway over people’s minds.
rows.zh: 只要人们仍受这些区别支配，把我们与原始人、把我们与野蛮人、把我们与异教徒截然划开，那么从定义上说，人类学就不可能成立。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was necessary first to arrive at that degree of sophistication where we no longer set our own belief against our neighbour’s superstition.
rows.zh: 首先，认识必须成熟到不再把自己的观念当作信仰，却把邻人的观念贬作迷信。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It was necessary to recognize that these institutions which are based on the same premises, let us say the supernatural, must be considered together, our own among the rest.
rows.zh: 必须承认，立足于相同前提——比如超自然观念——的各种制度，应放在一起考察，我们自己的制度也不例外。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: moment 在此指重要性，属较正式用法，而非一小段时间。
usage.example: Custom has not commonly been regarded as a subject of any great moment.
usage.exampleZh: 习俗通常并不被视为一个多么重要的研究课题。

usage.note: 表示实际关系与前述的方向或顺序相反。
usage.example: As a matter of fact, it is the other way around.
usage.exampleZh: 事实上，情况恰恰相反。

usage.note: 强调并非玩笑或夸张，而是严肃提出的判断。
usage.example: John Dewey has said in all seriousness that the part played by custom in shaping the behaviour of the individual, as against any way in which he can affect traditional custom, is as the proportion of the total vocabulary of his mother tongue against those words of his own baby talk that are taken up into the vernacular of his family.
usage.exampleZh: 约翰·杜威曾十分严肃地说，习俗对塑造个人行为的影响，与个人以任何方式改变传统习俗的影响相比，其比例就像他母语的全部词汇量，与他幼儿时期所说、后来被家人纳入口头用语的那些话的数量之比。

usage.note: 不仅表示顺序靠前，更突出首要地位。
usage.example: The life history of the individual is first and foremost an accommodation to the patterns and standards traditionally handed down in his community.
usage.exampleZh: 个人的生活史，首先而且最主要的，是不断适应其社区世代相传的模式和标准的过程。

usage.note: 常用于观念、势力对人或地区的支配，sway 在此为名词。
usage.example: Anthropology was by definition impossible, as long as these distinctions between ourselves and the primitive, ourselves and the barbarian, ourselves and the pagan, held sway over people’s minds.
usage.exampleZh: 只要人们仍受这些区别支配，把我们与原始人、把我们与野蛮人、把我们与异教徒截然划开，那么从定义上说，人类学就不可能成立。

rows.en: In man’s early days, competition with other creatures must have been critical.
rows.zh: 在人类早期，与其他生物的竞争必定关系到生死存亡。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But this phase of our development is now finished.
rows.zh: 但我们发展的这个阶段如今已经结束。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Indeed, we lack practice and experience nowadays in dealing with primitive conditions.
rows.zh: 事实上，现在我们已缺乏应付原始环境的实践和经验。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I am sure that, without modern weapons, I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear, and in this I do not think that I stand alone.
rows.zh: 我确信，如果没有现代武器，要和一头熊争一个山洞的所有权，我会表现得十分狼狈；而在这一点上，我想绝不只是我一个人如此。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The last creature to compete with man was the mosquito.
rows.zh: 最后一种与人类竞争的生物是蚊子。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But even the mosquito has been subdued by attention to drainage and by chemical sprays.
rows.zh: 不过，即使是蚊子，也已通过重视排水和喷洒化学药剂而被制服。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Competition between ourselves, person against person, community against community, still persists, however; and it is as fierce as it ever was.
rows.zh: 然而，我们人类内部的竞争——个人对个人、群体对群体——仍在继续，而且和以往一样激烈。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But the competition of man against man is not the simple process envisioned in biology.
rows.zh: 但是，人与人之间的竞争，并不是生物学所设想的那种简单过程。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is not a simple competition for a fixed amount of food determined by the physical environment, because the environment that determines our evolution is no longer essentially physical.
rows.zh: 它并非只是争夺由自然环境决定的固定数量的食物，因为决定我们演化的环境，已不再主要是物质环境。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Our environment is chiefly conditioned by the things we believe.
rows.zh: 我们的环境主要受我们信奉的观念制约。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Morocco and California are bits of the Earth in very similar latitudes, both on the west coasts of continents with similar climates, and probably with rather similar natural resources.
rows.zh: 摩洛哥和加利福尼亚位于地球上十分相近的纬度，都在大陆西岸，气候相似，自然资源可能也颇相近。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Yet their present development is wholly different, not so much because of different people even, but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
rows.zh: 然而，两地目前的发展全然不同；这与其说是因为人群不同，甚至不如说是因为居民头脑中的思想不同。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: This is the point I wish to emphasize.
rows.zh: 这就是我想强调的一点。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The most important factor in our environment is the state of our own minds.
rows.zh: 我们环境中最重要的因素，是我们自身的思想状态。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is well known that where the white man has invaded a primitive culture, the most destructive effects have come not from physical weapons but from ideas.
rows.zh: 众所周知，在白人侵入原始文化的地方，破坏最强的影响并非来自物质武器，而是来自思想。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Ideas are dangerous.
rows.zh: 思想是危险的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.
rows.zh: 宗教裁判所昔日下令烧死异端者时，对这一点十分清楚。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Indeed, the concept of free speech only exists in our modern society because when you are inside a community, you are conditioned by the conventions of the community to such a degree that it is very difficult to conceive of anything really destructive.
rows.zh: 事实上，言论自由这一观念之所以能在现代社会存在，只是因为当你身处一个社群内部时，会受到该社群惯例的深刻制约，以至于很难设想出任何真正具有破坏性的思想。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is only someone looking on from outside that can inject the dangerous thoughts.
rows.zh: 只有从外部观察的人，才能注入那些危险的思想。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I do not doubt that it would be possible to inject ideas into the modern world that would utterly destroy us.
rows.zh: 我毫不怀疑，完全有可能向现代世界注入某些观念，将我们彻底毁灭。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I would like to give you an example, but fortunately I cannot do so.
rows.zh: 我很想举个例子给各位听，但幸运的是，我举不出来。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Perhaps it will suffice to mention the nuclear bomb.
rows.zh: 也许提到核弹就足够了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Imagine the effect on a reasonably advanced technological society, one that still does not possess the bomb, of making it aware of the possibility, of supplying sufficient details to enable the thing to be constructed.
rows.zh: 设想一下，对于一个技术相当先进、却还没有核弹的社会，如果让它知道核弹有可能制造出来，并提供足够的细节，使它能够造出来，会产生什么影响。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Twenty or thirty pages of information handed to any of the major world powers around the year 1925 would have been sufficient to change the course of world history.
rows.zh: 在一九二五年前后，只要把二三十页资料交给任何一个世界主要强国，就足以改变世界历史的进程。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one, that twenty or thirty pages of ideas and information would be capable of turning the present-day world upside down, or even destroying it.
rows.zh: 二三十页思想和资料竟能够使当今世界天翻地覆，甚至毁灭它；这是个奇怪的想法，但我相信它是正确的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: I have often tried to conceive of what those pages might contain, but of course I cannot do so because I am a prisoner of the present-day world, just as all of you are.
rows.zh: 我常常试图设想那些页上会写些什么，当然却想不出来，因为我和各位一样，都是当今世界的囚徒。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We cannot think outside the particular patterns that our brains are conditioned to, or, to be more accurate, we can think only a very little way outside, and then only if we are very original.
rows.zh: 我们无法跳出大脑已经习惯的特定思维模式；或者更准确地说，我们只能向模式之外想一点点，而且即便这样，也只有极富独创性才办得到。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 后接问题或环境，表示采取行动去应对。
usage.example: Indeed, we lack practice and experience nowadays in dealing with primitive conditions.
usage.exampleZh: 事实上，现在我们已缺乏应付原始环境的实践和经验。

usage.matchedForm: make a very poor show of
usage.note: show 在此指表现，of 后接名词或动名词。
usage.example: I am sure that, without modern weapons, I would make a very poor show of disputing the ownership of a cave with a bear, and in this I do not think that I stand alone.
usage.exampleZh: 我确信，如果没有现代武器，要和一头熊争一个山洞的所有权，我会表现得十分狼狈；而在这一点上，我想绝不只是我一个人如此。

usage.note: not so much ... but ... 将重点从前一解释移到后一解释；原句以 because of 引出两种原因，even 进一步弱化前一项。
usage.example: Yet their present development is wholly different, not so much because of different people even, but because of the different thoughts that exist in the minds of their inhabitants.
usage.exampleZh: 然而，两地目前的发展全然不同；这与其说是因为人群不同，甚至不如说是因为居民头脑中的思想不同。

usage.note: 较有叙述色彩的过去时间表达。
usage.example: The Holy Office knew this full well when it caused heretics to be burned in days gone by.
usage.exampleZh: 宗教裁判所昔日下令烧死异端者时，对这一点十分清楚。

usage.matchedForm: turning the present-day world upside down
usage.note: turn something upside down 除实际翻转外，也可比喻彻底打乱现状。
usage.example: It is a strange thought, but I believe a correct one, that twenty or thirty pages of ideas and information would be capable of turning the present-day world upside down, or even destroying it.
usage.exampleZh: 二三十页思想和资料竟能够使当今世界天翻地覆，甚至毁灭它；这是个奇怪的想法，但我相信它是正确的。

rows.en: A gifted American psychologist has said, ‘Worry is a spasm of the emotion; the mind catches hold of something and will not let it go.’
rows.zh: 一位有才华的美国心理学家曾说：“忧虑是情感的痉挛；心灵抓住了某个东西，便不肯放手。”
rows.speaker: 旁白 / 美国心理学家

rows.en: It is useless to argue with the mind in this condition.
rows.zh: 在这种状态下，与心灵争辩是徒劳的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The stronger the will, the more futile the task.
rows.zh: 意志越强，这样做就越没有用。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: One can only gently insinuate something else into its convulsive grasp.
rows.zh: 人只能轻轻把别的东西塞进它那痉挛般紧抓的手中。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: And if this something else is rightly chosen, if it is really attended by the illumination of another field of interest, gradually, and often quite swiftly, the old undue grip relaxes and the process of recuperation and repair begins.
rows.zh: 如果这别的东西选得恰当，如果它确实伴随着另一个兴趣领域带来的启迪，那么原先那种过度的紧抓就会渐渐松开，而且往往相当迅速，复原与修复的过程便开始了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest is therefore a policy of the first importance to a public man.
rows.zh: 因此，对一个从事公共事务的人来说，培养一种业余爱好和新的兴趣形式，是头等重要的方针。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But this is not a business that can be undertaken in a day or swiftly improvised by a mere command of the will.
rows.zh: 但这并不是一天之内就能办成的事，也不是光靠一道意志的命令就能迅速应付出来的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The growth of alternative mental interests is a long process.
rows.zh: 培养能替换原有心智活动的其他兴趣，是个漫长的过程。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The seeds must be carefully chosen; they must fall on good ground; they must be sedulously tended, if the vivifying fruits are to be at hand when needed.
rows.zh: 种子必须仔细挑选，必须落在好土里，也必须悉心照料，才能在需要时，随手获得那些使人恢复活力的果实。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: To be really happy and really safe, one ought to have at least two or three hobbies, and they must all be real.
rows.zh: 要真正幸福、真正安稳，人至少应有两三种爱好，而且都必须是真正的爱好。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is no use starting late in life to say: ‘I will take an interest in this or that.’
rows.zh: 到了晚年才开始说“我要对这个或那个感兴趣”，是没有用的。
rows.speaker: 旁白 / 假想的自语

rows.en: Such an attempt only aggravates the strain of mental effort.
rows.zh: 这种尝试只会加重精神用力的紧张。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: A man may acquire great knowledge of topics unconnected with his daily work, and yet get hardly any benefit or relief.
rows.zh: 一个人也许对与日常工作毫不相关的话题获得了大量知识，却几乎得不到任何益处或解脱。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is no use doing what you like; you have got to like what you do.
rows.zh: 光做自己喜欢的事没有用；你必须喜欢自己正在做的事。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Broadly speaking, human beings may be divided into three classes: those who are toiled to death, those who are worried to death, and those who are bored to death.
rows.zh: 大体说来，人可以分成三类：劳累致死的人、忧虑致死的人和无聊致死的人。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is no use offering the manual labourer, tired out with a hard week's sweat and effort, the chance of playing a game of football or baseball on Saturday afternoon.
rows.zh: 一个体力劳动者经过一周艰苦的流汗出力，已筋疲力尽，星期六下午再给他一次踢足球或打棒球的机会，是没有用的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It is no use inviting the politician or the professional or business man, who has been working or worrying about serious things for six days, to work or worry about trifling things at the weekend.
rows.zh: 一个政客、专业人士或商人，已连续六天为重要事情忙碌或忧虑，再请他周末为琐事忙碌或忧虑，也是没有用的。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: As for the unfortunate people who can command everything they want, who can gratify every caprice and lay their hands on almost every object of desire—for them a new pleasure, a new excitement is only an additional satiation.
rows.zh: 至于那些不幸的人，他们能得到任何想要的东西，能满足每一时兴起的念头，几乎能把一切欲求之物拿到手；对他们来说，一种新乐趣、一番新刺激，只会再增添一层餍足与厌腻。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In vain they rush frantically round from place to place, trying to escape from avenging boredom by mere clatter and motion.
rows.zh: 他们发狂般四处奔走，想仅凭喧闹和活动躲开报复般追来的无聊，却徒劳无功。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For them discipline in one form or another is the most hopeful path.
rows.zh: 对他们来说，某种形式的自我约束，是最有希望的出路。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It may also be said that rational, industrious, useful human beings are divided into two classes: first, those whose work is work and whose pleasure is pleasure; and secondly, those whose work and pleasure are one.
rows.zh: 也可以说，理智、勤勉而有用的人分为两类：第一类是工作归工作、娱乐归娱乐的人；第二类是工作和娱乐融为一体的人。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Of these the former are the majority.
rows.zh: 两者之中，前一类占多数。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: They have their compensations.
rows.zh: 他们也有自己的补偿。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The long hours in the office or the factory bring with them as their reward, not only the means of sustenance, but a keen appetite for pleasure even in its simplest and most modest forms.
rows.zh: 在办公室或工厂里工作的漫长时光，带来的报偿不仅是维持生活的收入，也使人对娱乐产生强烈的渴望，哪怕那娱乐最简单、最朴素。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But Fortune's favoured children belong to the second class.
rows.zh: 但幸运女神宠爱的孩子属于第二类。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Their life is a natural harmony.
rows.zh: 他们的生活天然和谐。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For them the working hours are never long enough.
rows.zh: 对他们来说，工作时间永远不够长。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Each day is a holiday, and ordinary holidays, when they come, are grudged as enforced interruptions in an absorbing vocation.
rows.zh: 每天都是假日，而通常所谓的假期到来时，却被他们看作对引人入胜的事业的强行打断，心中不愿接受。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Yet to both classes, the need of an alternative outlook, of a change of atmosphere, of a diversion of effort, is essential.
rows.zh: 然而，对这两类人来说，都必不可少的是换一种眼光、换一种氛围，把精力转投别处。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Indeed, it may well be that those whose work is their pleasure are those who most need the means of banishing it at intervals from their minds.
rows.zh: 事实上，很可能恰恰是那些把工作当乐趣的人，最需要有办法时不时把工作从脑海里赶出去。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 可以指实际抓取，也可以像此处一样比喻思想紧扣某事。
usage.example: A gifted American psychologist has said, ‘Worry is a spasm of the emotion; the mind catches hold of something and will not let it go.’
usage.exampleZh: 一位有才华的美国心理学家曾说：“忧虑是情感的痉挛；心灵抓住了某个东西，便不肯放手。”

usage.note: of 加抽象名词可表示性质，the first 强调首要程度。
usage.example: The cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest is therefore a policy of the first importance to a public man.
usage.exampleZh: 因此，对一个从事公共事务的人来说，培养一种业余爱好和新的兴趣形式，是头等重要的方针。

usage.note: 常用 it 作形式主语，后面的动名词短语说明无益的行为。
usage.example: It is no use doing what you like; you have got to like what you do.
usage.exampleZh: 光做自己喜欢的事没有用；你必须喜欢自己正在做的事。

usage.note: 提示后面的分类或判断是概括性的。
usage.example: Broadly speaking, human beings may be divided into three classes: those who are toiled to death, those who are worried to death, and those who are bored to death.
usage.exampleZh: 大体说来，人可以分成三类：劳累致死的人、忧虑致死的人和无聊致死的人。

usage.note: 说明努力没有达到目的，可置于句首加强语气。
usage.example: In vain they rush frantically round from place to place, trying to escape from avenging boredom by mere clatter and motion.
usage.exampleZh: 他们发狂般四处奔走，想仅凭喧闹和活动躲开报复般追来的无聊，却徒劳无功。

usage.note: 强调间歇发生，不一定指固定间隔。
usage.example: Indeed, it may well be that those whose work is their pleasure are those who most need the means of banishing it at intervals from their minds.
usage.exampleZh: 事实上，很可能恰恰是那些把工作当乐趣的人，最需要有办法时不时把工作从脑海里赶出去。

rows.en: Economy is one powerful motive for camping, since after the initial outlay upon equipment, or through hiring it, the total expense can be far less than the cost of hotels.
rows.zh: 节省开支是露营的一大动机，因为除去最初购置装备的花费，或通过租用装备，总费用可以远低于住旅馆。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But, contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only one, or even the greatest.
rows.zh: 但与流行的看法相反，省钱远非唯一动机，甚至并非最大动机。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The man who manoeuvres carelessly into his twenty pounds’ worth of space at one of Europe’s myriad permanent sites may find himself bumping a Bentley.
rows.zh: 一个人若漫不经心地把车驶进欧洲无数固定营地之一、自己花二十英镑租来的那块地方，可能会发现自己撞上了一辆宾利。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: More likely, Ford Escort will be hub to hub with Renault or Mercedes, but rarely with bicycles made for two.
rows.zh: 更可能的情景是，福特 Escort 与雷诺或梅赛德斯的轮毂紧挨着轮毂，却很少与双人自行车并排。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: That the equipment of modern camping becomes yearly more sophisticated is an entertaining paradox for the cynic, a brighter promise for the hopeful traveller who has sworn to get away from it all.
rows.zh: 现代露营装备一年比一年精巧；对愤世嫉俗者而言，这是个有趣的悖论，对发誓要远离一切烦扰、满怀期待的旅行者而言，却是更光明的许诺。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: It also provides—and some student sociologist might care to base his thesis upon the phenomenon—an escape of another kind.
rows.zh: 它也提供了另一种逃离——也许某个社会学学生会愿意以这一现象为基础写篇论文。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The modern traveller is often a man who dislikes the Splendide and the Bellavista, not because he cannot afford, or shuns their material comforts, but because he is afraid of them.
rows.zh: 现代旅行者常常不喜欢住“华丽”或“美景”那样的大饭店，并非因为住不起或逃避它们的物质舒适，而是因为害怕它们。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Affluent he may be, but he is by no means sure what to tip the doorman or the chambermaid.
rows.zh: 他或许富有，却完全拿不准该给门童或客房女服务员多少小费。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Master in his own house, he has little idea of when to say boo to a maître d’hôtel.
rows.zh: 他在自己家里是主人，却不大知道该在什么时候对餐厅领班开口表示不满。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: From all such fears camping releases him.
rows.zh: 露营使他摆脱所有这类恐惧。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Granted, a snobbery of camping itself, based upon equipment and techniques, already exists; but it is of a kind that, if he meets it, he can readily understand and deal with.
rows.zh: 诚然，露营本身已经出现了以装备和技巧论高下的势利风气；但即使碰到，他也很容易理解并应付这种风气。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There is no superior ‘they’ in the shape of managements and hotel hierarchies to darken his holiday days.
rows.zh: 那里没有由管理人员和饭店各级人员构成的、高高在上的“他们”，来给他的假日蒙上阴影。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: To such motives, yet another must be added.
rows.zh: 除了这些动机，还必须再加上一个。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The contemporary phenomenon of car worship is to be explained not least by the sense of independence and freedom that ownership entails.
rows.zh: 当代人对汽车的崇拜，至少有相当一部分原因，是拥有汽车带来的独立与自由感。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: To this pleasure camping gives an exquisite refinement.
rows.zh: 露营又使这种乐趣变得格外精妙。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: From one’s own front door to home or foreign hills or sands and back again, everything is to hand.
rows.zh: 从自家前门出发，到国内或国外的山野、沙滩，再返回家中，一切都在手边。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Not only are the means of arriving at the holiday paradise entirely within one’s own command and keeping, but the means of escape from holiday hell (if the beach proves too crowded, the local weather too inclement) are there, outside—or, as likely, part of—the tent.
rows.zh: 不仅到达度假天堂的交通工具完全由自己掌握和保管，逃离度假地狱的工具也随时在帐篷外面——或者很可能就是帐篷的一部分——等着自己，万一海滩太拥挤、当地天气太恶劣就能离开。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Idealists have objected to the practice of camping, as to the package tour, that the traveller abroad thereby denies himself the opportunity of getting to know the people of the country visited.
rows.zh: 理想主义者反对露营，也反对包价旅游，理由是出国的旅行者因此失去了了解所访国家人民的机会。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Insularity and self-containment, it is argued, go hand in hand.
rows.zh: 有人认为，闭塞与自给自足总是相伴而行。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The opinion does not survive experience of a popular Continental camping place.
rows.zh: 只要到欧洲大陆一个热门营地亲身体验，这种看法就站不住脚了。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Holiday hotels tend to cater for one nationality of visitors especially, sometimes exclusively.
rows.zh: 度假旅馆往往主要迎合某一个国籍的客人，有时甚至只接待该国客人。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Camping sites, by contrast, are highly cosmopolitan.
rows.zh: 相比之下，露营地却十分国际化。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Granted, a preponderance of Germans is a characteristic that seems common to most Mediterranean sites; but as yet there is no overwhelmingly specialized patronage.
rows.zh: 诚然，德国人占多数似乎是大多数地中海营地共有的特点，但迄今还没有哪个营地的顾客压倒性地局限于某一国籍。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Notices forbidding the open-air drying of clothes, or the use of water points for car washing, or those inviting ‘our camping friends’ to a dance or a boat trip are printed not only in French or Italian or Spanish, but also in English, German and Dutch.
rows.zh: 禁止露天晾衣、禁止用供水点洗车的告示，以及邀请“我们的露营朋友”参加舞会或乘船游览的通知，不仅用法语、意大利语或西班牙语印制，还用英语、德语和荷兰语印制。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: At meal times the odour of sauerkraut vies with that of garlic.
rows.zh: 用餐时，酸菜的气味与大蒜的气味争相飘散。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The Frenchman's breakfast coffee competes with the Englishman’s bacon and eggs.
rows.zh: 法国人早餐咖啡的香气，又与英国人的培根煎蛋气味争相较量。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Whether the remarkable growth of organized camping means the eventual death of the more independent kind is hard to say.
rows.zh: 有组织露营的显著增长，是否意味着更加独立自主的露营方式最终会消亡，还很难说。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Municipalities naturally want to secure the campers’ site fees and other custom.
rows.zh: 各市镇自然希望获得露营者的场地费和其他消费收入。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Police are wary of itinerants who cannot be traced to a recognized camp boundary or to four walls.
rows.zh: 警察会提防那些无法追查到某个正式营地范围内或固定住处的流动人员。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But most probably it will all depend upon campers themselves: how many heath fires they cause; how much litter they leave; in short, whether or not they wholly alienate landowners and those who live in the countryside.
rows.zh: 但最终情况多半还是取决于露营者自己：他们造成多少荒野火灾，丢下多少垃圾；总之，看他们是否把地主和乡村居民彻底惹恼。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Only good scouting is likely to preserve the freedoms so dear to the heart of the eternal Boy Scout.
rows.zh: 只有良好的童子军式户外操守，才有可能保住那些为永远怀着童子军之心的人所珍爱的自由。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 此处后接 being，强调与某种描述相距很远。
usage.example: But, contrary to a popular assumption, it is far from being the only one, or even the greatest.
usage.exampleZh: 但与流行的看法相反，省钱远非唯一动机，甚至并非最大动机。

usage.note: 常用于度假，it all 指平日的压力和事务。
usage.example: That the equipment of modern camping becomes yearly more sophisticated is an entertaining paradox for the cynic, a brighter promise for the hopeful traveller who has sworn to get away from it all.
usage.exampleZh: 现代露营装备一年比一年精巧；对愤世嫉俗者而言，这是个有趣的悖论，对发誓要远离一切烦扰、满怀期待的旅行者而言，却是更光明的许诺。

usage.note: 强烈否定表达，置于句首时通常引起部分倒装。
usage.example: Affluent he may be, but he is by no means sure what to tip the doorman or the chambermaid.
usage.exampleZh: 他或许富有，却完全拿不准该给门童或客房女服务员多少小费。

usage.meaning: 尤其；至少在很大程度上
usage.note: 引入不应被低估的重要原因，并非表示最不重要。
usage.example: The contemporary phenomenon of car worship is to be explained not least by the sense of independence and freedom that ownership entails.
usage.exampleZh: 当代人对汽车的崇拜，至少有相当一部分原因，是拥有汽车带来的独立与自由感。

usage.note: 形容两种现象密切相关、同时出现。
usage.example: Insularity and self-containment, it is argued, go hand in hand.
usage.exampleZh: 有人认为，闭塞与自给自足总是相伴而行。

usage.note: 后接服务对象或需求，不能一律理解为提供餐饮。
usage.example: Holiday hotels tend to cater for one nationality of visitors especially, sometimes exclusively.
usage.exampleZh: 度假旅馆往往主要迎合某一个国籍的客人，有时甚至只接待该国客人。

rows.en: There is no shortage of tipsters around offering ‘get-rich-quick’ opportunities.
rows.zh: 四周从来不缺提供“迅速发财”机会的荐股者。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But if you are a serious private investor, leave the Las Vegas mentality to those with money to fritter.
rows.zh: 但如果你是个认真的个人投资者，就把拉斯维加斯式的赌博心态留给那些有钱挥霍的人。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The serious investor needs a proper ‘portfolio’—a well-planned selection of investments, with a definite structure and a clear aim.
rows.zh: 认真的投资者需要一个恰当的“投资组合”——经过周密选择、结构明确、目标清楚的一组投资。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: But exactly how does a newcomer to the stock market go about achieving that?
rows.zh: 不过，一个刚进入股市的人，究竟该怎样着手做到这一点呢？
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Well, if you go to five reputable stock brokers and ask them what you should do with your money, you're likely to get five different answers,—even if you give all the relevant information about your age, family, finances and what you want from your investments.
rows.zh: 假如你找五家信誉良好的证券经纪商，问他们你的钱该怎么用，很可能会得到五种不同的答案，即使你已提供了关于年龄、家庭、财务状况和投资期望的全部相关信息。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Moral?
rows.zh: 这里的启示是什么？
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: There is no one ‘right’ way to structure a portfolio.
rows.zh: 安排投资组合，并没有唯一“正确”的方法。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: However, there are undoubtedly some wrong ways, and you can be sure that none of our five advisers would have suggested sinking all (or perhaps any) of your money into Periwigs.
rows.zh: 不过，错误的方法无疑还是有的；你可以肯定，这五位顾问没有一个会建议你把全部资金，甚至也许哪怕一部分资金，投进“佩里维格斯”公司。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: So what should you do?
rows.zh: 那么，你该怎么办呢？
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: We’ll assume that you have sorted out the basics—like mortgages, pensions, insurance and access to sufficient cash reserves.
rows.zh: 我们假定，你已经处理好基本事项，例如住房抵押贷款、养老金、保险，以及确保有足够的现金储备可供动用。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: You should then establish your own individual aims.
rows.zh: 接着，你应该确立自己个人的目标。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: These are partly a matter of personal circumstances, partly a matter of psychology.
rows.zh: 这些目标部分取决于个人处境，部分取决于心理因素。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: For instance, if you are older you have less time to recover from any major losses, and you may well wish to boost your pension income.
rows.zh: 例如，如果你年纪较大，就没有那么多时间从重大损失中恢复，而且你很可能希望增加养老金收入。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: So preserving your capital and generating extra income are your main priorities.
rows.zh: 因此，保住本金并产生额外收入，是你的首要任务。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: In this case, you'd probably construct a portfolio with some shares (but not high risk ones), along with gilts, cash deposits, and perhaps convertibles or the income shares of split capital investment trusts.
rows.zh: 在这种情况下，你大概会构建这样的投资组合：包括一些股票，但不包括高风险股票，再配上英国国债、现金存款，也许还有可转换证券，或者分割资本投资信托的收益股。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If you are younger, and in a solid financial position, you may decide to take an aggressive approach— but only if you're blessed with a sanguine disposition and won't suffer sleepless nights over share prices.
rows.zh: 如果你较年轻，财务状况又稳健，或许会决定采取进取策略，但前提是你天性乐观，不会为股价辗转失眠。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: If you recognize yourself in this description, you might include a couple of heady growth stocks in your portfolio, alongside your more pedestrian investments.
rows.zh: 如果你觉得这正是在说自己，可以在比较平稳普通的投资之外，在组合中加入一两只增长势头强劲、令人兴奋的成长股。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: Once you have decided on your investment aims, you can then decide where to put your money.
rows.zh: 一旦确定了投资目标，你便可以决定把钱放到哪里。
rows.speaker: 旁白

rows.en: The golden rule here is spread your risk—if you put all of your money into Periwigs International, you're setting yourself up as a hostage to fortune.
rows.zh: 这里的金科玉律是分散风险；如果把所有钱都投进“佩里维格斯国际公司”，你就是在让自己听任命运摆布。
rows.speaker: 旁白

usage.note: 后接动名词，询问完成事情的方法或步骤。
usage.example: But exactly how does a newcomer to the stock market go about achieving that?
usage.exampleZh: 不过，一个刚进入股市的人，究竟该怎样着手做到这一点呢？

usage.note: 此处指先安排好投资之前的基本财务事项。
usage.example: We’ll assume that you have sorted out the basics—like mortgages, pensions, insurance and access to sufficient cash reserves.
usage.exampleZh: 我们假定，你已经处理好基本事项，例如住房抵押贷款、养老金、保险，以及确保有足够的现金储备可供动用。

usage.note: 可用于疾病、损失或打击，此处讲弥补重大投资损失。
usage.example: For instance, if you are older you have less time to recover from any major losses, and you may well wish to boost your pension income.
usage.exampleZh: 例如，如果你年纪较大，就没有那么多时间从重大损失中恢复，而且你很可能希望增加养老金收入。

usage.note: be blessed with 后接令人满意的品质或条件，表示有幸拥有；原文为 you’re blessed with，指天性乐观。
usage.example: If you are younger, and in a solid financial position, you may decide to take an aggressive approach— but only if you're blessed with a sanguine disposition and won't suffer sleepless nights over share prices.
usage.exampleZh: 如果你较年轻，财务状况又稳健，或许会决定采取进取策略，但前提是你天性乐观，不会为股价辗转失眠。

usage.meaning: 听任运气摆布的人；易受不测影响的处境
usage.note: 固定比喻，表示把自己暴露在难以控制的风险中。
usage.example: The golden rule here is spread your risk—if you put all of your money into Periwigs International, you're setting yourself up as a hostage to fortune.
usage.exampleZh: 这里的金科玉律是分散风险；如果把所有钱都投进“佩里维格斯国际公司”，你就是在让自己听任命运摆布。
